correctness.rationale: For SPD H and fixed W=ω(H)≻0, S=W^{1/2} commutes with H. α_I(Su)=α_W(u), and S maps every cone pair v=(I−αH)u bijectively to another cone pair. Therefore S_× T_W=T_I S_×, including zero/termination, so S_× T_W^k=T_I^k S_× for all k≥0. By ||z||_{W,×}=||S_×z||_× and the cone bijection, change variables inside the supremum to get A_k(W)=A_k(I) exactly, and the dependent N_θ and C_W(ρ) identities. Source Proposition 3.1 verifies cone invariance and Lemma 3.3 verifies warm-up realizability. originality.rationale: Not a separately original mathematical result. The full earlier primary arXiv:2609.12100v1, Proposition 3.2 and the paragraph before it, proves the exact cone bijection and all-iterate conjugacy. Its Section 2 defines finite-horizon normalized gains. The reported A_k(W)=A_k(I) is the standard norm pullback along that bijection; first contraction horizon and sup-rate prefactor then coincide by definitions. The prior result already implies all central claims, despite not using the same notation or explicitly claiming an equality in matched norms.
residual_risks: The same preprint may have later revisions; the decisive direct implication is established for the inspected 2026-09-10 v1 and is unaffected by absent exact wording.
The result is mathematically correct and might be useful as an explanatory observation, but that usefulness does not confer independent originality.
No exhaustive survey of every normed-dynamical-systems textbook was needed because the concrete primary theorem already implies the claim.

value.rationale: The finite-horizon gain is a meaningful BB quantity, but this submission neither evaluates A_k nor improves bounds in a common meaningful metric. It defines for each weighted algorithm precisely the pullback norm that makes an already established conjugacy isometric. Equality of all k-step ratios, contraction horizons and sup-based prefactors then requires only the generic one-line coordinate-change tautology. This is an elementary explanatory reformulation of the existing proposition, not a motivated new structural lemma, computation, boundary, classification or non-implied exact invariant. The absence of a condition-number factor is achieved only by changing the metric separately for each algorithm, not by a new optimization estimate.
residual_risks: It can have pedagogical value for interpreting norm-dependence, but the independent mathematical contribution falls below the shared substantive-value bar.
